speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.ranked: When nobody else is found within a minute in the ranked queue, race the Tascade bot instead. The bot races to a time set by your elo, and the match changes your elo and PP like any other.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.matchS: Play a sound when an opponent is found, when a vote starts, passes or expires, when the seed changes, and for the match result.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.cheats: Create run worlds with cheats on, so commands like /gamemode, /tp and /give work. Runs with cheats are unrated: they give no elo or PP and aren't saved to your history. In ranked you're only matched with players who also have cheats on, or with the bot. Solo picks this up at the next run or seed change, ranked at the next match.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.discor: Show what you're doing in Tascade on your Discord profile: browsing, queuing, racing (and who against), or watching a replay. Needs the Discord app running.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.raceHu: The standings at the side of the screen during a run: where you and your opponent are, and who's ahead.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.oppone: Chat with your ranked opponent. Off, their messages aren't shown and yours aren't sent. Match notices, like votes, and their advancements (see Opponent Advancements) still show.
Show your ranked opponent's advancements in chat. The race HUD keeps following their progress either way.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.hideRo: Show custom room codes as asterisks, for streaming without giving your room away. Copy Code still copies the real code.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.rememb: Keep the run modifiers you picked after closing the game. Off, they're cleared each time the game starts.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.pauseM: Seconds the run buttons you can't take back (Forfeit Match, Exit Run, Leave Race, Reset World, Change Seed and the votes) stay disabled each time you open the pause menu, so a stray click doesn't hit one. 0 turns it off. Ranked's two-minute wait before you can forfeit still applies on top.
speedrunapi.config.tascade.option.replay: Keep the replay of a solo run you beat.
Keep the replay of a solo run you left before finishing it.
Keep the replay of a solo world you swapped for a new seed.
Keep the replay of a ranked match you won, by finishing first or because your opponent forfeited.
Keep the replay of a ranked match your opponent won by finishing first.
Keep the replay of a ranked match that ended without a winner: a draw both players agreed to, or a match the server called off.
Keep the replay of a ranked match you forfeited, or left by closing the game.
Keep the replay of a ranked world you and your opponent voted to swap for a new seed.
The fastest playback speed a replay plays sounds at (from 0.5x up). Sounds are sped up and pitched to match the playback speed.
